notes.title: Ver. 1.0.9
notes.content:
Reasonably important update, so stay with me here.

[list]
[*] Removed the opening cutscene's custom name (sorry)
[*] Made the first playthrough of the tutorial take you to level one after beating it
[*] Added functionality for changing Feverish Knight's sprite (Instructions below)
[/list]

[b]To change Feverish Knight's Sprite, add a PNG to AppData/LocalLow/1actose/Knight And Mourning/ and name it "Feverish-Knight.png".[/b]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1079079920434679928/1152027718536405022/image.png[/img]

[i](to return the old sprite, just delete/rename the current image in its place and the game will re-install it for you.)[/i]
[i][b]
Thanks for playing![/b][/i]
